content: Hi, this is Jenna from HR! How can I assist you with today's payroll or benefits?
Hi Jenna, I just want to double-check that this month's salary went to my new checking account. My employee ID is 44598.
Of course, let me check our records for Employee 44598. I see the June payroll was processed for $3,210.50 and deposited to account ending in 3271 on June 28th. Is that your new Chase account?
Yes, 3271 is the one I set up. I didn't get the Zelle notification yet though. Normally it comes same day.

The Zelle transfer was issued from our payroll@tempcharm.com business account at 9:03 AM yesterday. The transaction reference is ZL20240628-9921. Sometimes there's a slight delay before you receive the bank alert, especially around month-end.
Alright, thanks for confirming. Can you send a confirmation to my email? It's jessie.millard@officeplus.net.

Absolutely, Jessie. I'll send the payment confirmation for payroll ID ZL20240628-9921 to jessie.millard@officeplus.net right away. If the funds aren't showing by 5 PM, let me know and I'll escalate it to our finance team.
Perfect, thanks so much. I'll keep an eye out for the email and let you know if anything changes.
